result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a loading indicator obscuring the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with green progress arc is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image, obscuring the food photo and making the card look incompletely loaded or broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card image finishes loading and dismiss the spinner once loaded; add proper loading placeholder and error fallback so the spinner does not persist over the image.
